title: DAMAGED
text: DAMAGED. The nesting boxes arrived damaged.  This was supposed to be for a gift.  They are unusable.  What a waste, now I need to find something else to put the gift in.

product_metadata.title: Kate Spade New York Black Decorative Storage Boxes with Lids, 3 Pack Sturdy Organizer Storage Bins, Includes Small Medium Large Pink Nesting Boxes with Magnetic Closure, Dots and Stripes
features: Set includes 3 decorative paper-wrapped greyboard boxes with magnetic close lids to keep your items organized and concealed
Each cute box is adorned with a gold spade logo and featured in different classic designs - the small box is in polka dots, the middle box is in apples, and the bottom box is in black stripes
Kate Spade's boxes with lids are sturdy and lightweight and fit down inside one another for easy, compact storage
Small Box: 3.25 inches (h) x 10 inches (w) x 7.75 inches (d); Medium Box: 4.125 inches (h) x 12 inches (w) x 8.75 inches (d); Large Box: 4.5 inches (h) x 14 inches (w) x 9.75 inches (d)
Stackable bin organizers are ideal for tucking away in closets, under beds, or on shelves and are perfect for supplies, notes, papers, receipts, cards…anything you want, really
